facts.fact: The article says payment institutions are licensed in the UMOA under the BCEAO instruction of 23 January 2024, which distinguishes payment institutions from banks, microfinance institutions and e-money institutions as payment service providers.
facts.system: BCEAO Instruction n°001-01-2024 on payment services in the UMOA

facts.fact: Per the BCEAO list at 31 August 2026 reported here, two payment institutions hold a licence in Burkina Faso, among 34 across the Union.
